answer: Because the beacon pair is tracked in the ripple ledger, the anchor audit records which half was completed and the cut is applied at settlement. Two answers per epoch doubles the authoring work per alias, so running 200 identities means 200 pairs of texts plus a separate attestation for each, which is exactly the labour a farm is trying to avoid. Full reward requires answering a second challenge with different words, and skipping it cuts the payout by 28%.
